intent: A Geist-calibre site header: transparent at rest, a hairline and blur fade in on scroll and the bar condenses 64 → 56px; one hover highlight glides between links and stretches toward its destination.

stack.animation: motion/react (motion values + animate for the highlight edges, layoutId for the current-route dot, variants with custom delays for the entrance, useInView for the demo's reveal-once)

layout.header: sticky top-0, full width; bar max-w 1280px, px 16/24px, is the @container
layout.height: 64px at rest, 56px after condenseAt (8px) of scroll
layout.desktop: ≥896px container: grid auto|1fr|auto; ≥1200px: 1fr|auto|1fr so links are centred on the page
layout.right: search chip (h-8, kbd ⌘K), Sign in text link, white primary button; gap 8px; whitespace-nowrap
layout.mobile: <896px: wordmark, 44px search icon, primary button from 672px, 44px burger; full-height menu under the bar with 56px rows and two 48px buttons at the bottom

typography.links: 13.5px, tracking -0.005em, white/55 → white on hover and when current
typography.kbd: font-mono 11px, ⌘K on Apple platforms, Ctrl K elsewhere

color.surface: black/72 + backdrop-blur-xl + saturate-150 + border-b white/9%; solid black while the menu is open
color.currentDot: 4px white circle under the current link
color.searchChip: inset ring white/10% (16% hover); kbd white/6% with an inset lower lip
color.approach: monochrome: black, white and greys only; surface/page/menu colours in one COLOR token object

motion.surface: separate layer, opacity 0→1 240ms ease-out, out 160ms ease-in
motion.highlight: two motion values (left/right edge); appear in place on first hover; leading edge spring 660/46, trailing edge spring 320/31 so it stretches toward the next link; fade out 160ms on leave
motion.currentDot: pops in once (scale 0→1, 300ms) after its link lands; afterwards layoutId on spring.ui 500/40 glides it between routes
motion.kbd: ⌘K / Ctrl K presses the chip 1px while held, then calls onSearch
motion.menu: fade 200ms; rows stagger 45ms (y 8→0, blur 6→0, 450ms ease-out), buttons follow
motion.reducedMotion: 150ms fades instead of rises; highlight jumps, no height tween, opacity-only menu
motion.entrance: first view ≤ 800ms: wordmark at 40ms, links from 120ms 45ms apart, then search chip, Sign in, primary button (or burger) from 360ms 45ms apart; each block opacity 0→1, y 8px→0, blur 6px→0, 450ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)
motion.demo: docs article: breadcrumb, headline, lead, meta stagger 60ms from 340ms; later sections reveal once at 25% visibility, waiting for the page intro if already on screen

responsive.1440: links centred on the page, search chip with label
responsive.768: burger menu, primary button stays in the bar

accessibility: nav aria-label=Main with aria-current=page on the current link
search chip aria-label names the shortcut, plus aria-keyshortcuts
burger has aria-expanded, aria-controls and a label that switches
menu is role=dialog aria-modal: scroll lock, Tab trapped, Escape closes and refocuses the burger, auto-closes at desktop width
highlight follows :focus-visible as well as the pointer
2px white/70 focus ring with a black offset; never on click

content.demo: a Kestrel docs article, 'Roll back a deploy in one command': breadcrumb, headline, lead, meta line, a CLI block and two short sections

avoid: a floating glass pill or glow behind the button
a rigid layoutId hover block without the edge stretch
measuring link offsetLeft through an ancestor that carries a filter or transform (it becomes the offsetParent); measure the list items
skeleton bars or a fake landing page as the demo stage
